name: c-sizeof-hover
description: Shows sizeof value when hovering over C variables

c-sizeof-hover.pointerSize.description: Size of a pointer in bytes (4 for ARM 32-bit)

c-sizeof-hover.charSize.description: Size of char type in bytes

c-sizeof-hover.shortSize.description: Size of short type in bytes

c-sizeof-hover.intSize.description: Size of int type in bytes

c-sizeof-hover.longSize.description: Size of long type in bytes (4 on ARM ILP32, 8 on LP64)

c-sizeof-hover.longLongSize.description: Size of long long type in bytes

c-sizeof-hover.floatSize.description: Size of float type in bytes

c-sizeof-hover.doubleSize.description: Size of double type in bytes

c-sizeof-hover.longDoubleSize.description: Size of long double type in bytes (8 on ARM)

c-sizeof-hover.enumSize.description: Size of enum type in bytes

c-sizeof-hover.showAlignment.description: Show struct/union member offsets and alignment details on hover

c-sizeof-hover.showPadding.description: Show explicit padding bytes in struct layout

c-sizeof-hover.showTypedefChain.description: Show the full typedef resolution chain

c-sizeof-hover.customTypeSizes.description: Custom size overrides for specific types (key: type name, value: size in bytes)

c-sizeof-hover.debug.description: Enable debug logging to output channel
